paper.abstract_en: Motivated by the experimental observations of $f_4(2050)$ and $f_4(2300)$ and the establishment of $a_4$ family, we investigate the $f_4$ family by combining the mass spectrum under the modified Godfrey--Isgur model with two-body strong-decay calculations in the quark-pair-creation model. The common pair-creation strength is fixed by the measured total width of $f_4(2050)$. The mass spectrum analysis and decay information both favor the nonstrange $2\,{}^3F_4$ assignment for $f_4(2300)$. The largely strange $2F$ partner is predicted at $2453$ MeV with a total width of $216$ MeV, decaying mainly into $K^*\bar K^*(1410)$ and $K^*\bar K^*$. Predictions are also given for the $3F$, $4F$, $1H$, and $2H$ flavor pairs. At the adopted mixing angles, the $H$-wave states are more than twice as broad as nearby $F$-wave states of the same flavor. The results of this work may serve as useful guidance for future experimental studies.
